summary:
Research of w134 (supervision r66, r81, r82) finished; notes.md is in the run directory.
All 5 accepted scenario cases fail at their first Given: the step definitions do not exist.
No-initiative `work run` today is an argparse error (scripts/work:100, initiative required); supervise.Run takes one initiative.
No gate, apply or formulate round exists (0 hits in scripts/supervise*.py), so r66's scenario needs r68/r85 rounds that w134 does not accept.
No code reads a capability-proposal's status; r81's second row needs a reader.
Single-initiative output (prints_end, prints_statuses, exits) is verified sound; no test pins the usage error.
Part 3 lists 15 old-form places (one initiative per Run: items, check, limit, lock, unlogged, branch review, print).
Probes P1-P6 ran in scratch repos only: no-arg usage error, awaiting-answer initiative, proposal ignored, unknown initiative, workers=0, uncommitted .shop/work.
No defect found by the probes.
Open conflicts A-D (proposal rounds scope, print format, shared branch, proposal reader) are in part 7 with both readings.
No map exists, so every test list is by search. refs misses scripts/work (no .py).
git status --porcelain is empty after the run; the scratch dir is ignored.
